title: Canonical finite-coefficient pullback family
statement: For the fixed common encoding of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding], construct the additive restriction isomorphism from the two underlying-sheaf encoding isomorphisms. Lift it with [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-restriction-linearity] to an internal-module isomorphism. Conjugate restriction through the ordinary inverse-image adjunctions and the objectwise encoding equivalences. Compose with the etale/pro-etale inverse-image comparison, derive these exact functors, restrict the etale source to D+, and identify exact internal inverse image with its total left derived functor. This defines a specified family of natural isomorphisms of the type CoefficientPullbackFamily in [def-weil-pbc-coefficient-derived-functor-api].

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemma 5.4.1; sectionwise coefficient encoding

proof.text: Build the additive restriction comparison explicitly by whiskering the two forget isomorphisms and the literal restriction identity.
Use Mod.isoMk and linearity, then obtain naturality by faithfulness of forgetting the module action.
Cancel the objectwise equivalences on the right. Apply conjugateIsoEquiv to the two composite adjunctions, obtaining the ordinary pro-etale pullback comparison.

Use comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso from the source library. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility, and leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory.
